description: Configuration schema for cellranger multi. This schema validates dependencies, references, outputs, and parameters required for running cellranger multi.

deps.description: Dependencies required for the workflow. These include paths to input files such as the captures and libraries CSV files.

captures.description: Path to the captures CSV file.

libraries.description: Path to the libraries CSV file.

fastqs.description: Optional path to the directory containing FASTQ files.

reports.description: Directory where cellranger reports will be generated.

ref.description: Reference dependencies used in the workflow.

gene-expression.description: Path to the reference transcriptome for gene expression.

feature.description: Path to the reference for feature barcode antibodies (if applicable).

vdj.description: Path to the reference for V(D)J libraries (if applicable).

logo.description: Path to the logo file for reports.

outs.description: Output directories where results and logs will be stored.

results.description: Directory where final results will be stored.

reports.description: Directory where cellranger reports will be generated.

logs.description: Directory where logs will be stored.

params.description: Parameters controlling workflow behavior, including advanced options for cellranger multi.

aggr.description: If true, aggregation will be performed.

annotate.description: If true, cell-type annotation is enabled.

hto.description: If true, HTO demux is enabled.

predemux.description: If true, predemux cell filtering is enabled.

gene-expression.description: Options for running cellranger count for gene expression libraries. Boolean options here are used to build CLI option strings.

create-bam.description: Whether to create a BAM file as part of the gene expression pipeline.

include-introns.description: If true, intronic reads are included.

chemistry.description: Specifies the library chemistry. Options are defined by 10X documentation.

check-library-compatibility.description: If true, the workflow checks for library compatibility.

expect-cells.description: Optional. The expected number of cells.

force-cells.description: Optional. The number of cells to force.

min-crispr-umi.description: Optional. The minimum CRISPR UMI count.

modules.description: Software modules versions when using environment modules

aggr.description: Version of cellranger module to use.
